subject: Physics
description: Zeroth, First, Second, Third laws of thermodynamics; entropy, heat-engines, Carnot cycle, refrigerator efficiency.

questions.stem: The FIRST LAW of thermodynamics is essentially a statement of:

options.option_text: Heat flows from hot to cold (a 2nd law)

questions.explanation: FIRST LAW OF THERMODYNAMICS: ENERGY CANNOT BE CREATED OR DESTROYED — only converted between forms. Mathematical: ΔU = Q − W (change in internal energy = heat added − work done by system). KEY APPLICATIONS: (1) STEAM ENGINE: heat input → work output + waste heat. (2) AUTOMOBILE ENGINE: chemical energy (fuel) → kinetic + thermal energy. (3) HUMAN BODY: food energy → mechanical work + body heat. PERPETUAL MOTION machines of FIRST KIND (creating energy from nothing) are FORBIDDEN by the 1st law. SIGN CONVENTION: Q positive when ADDED to system; W positive when DONE BY system on surroundings. ENERGY FORMS: kinetic, potential, thermal, chemical, electrical, nuclear, light, sound — all interconvertible. CONNECTION TO E=mc²: even mass and energy are interchangeable in relativity (1st law extends). HISTORICAL: developed by JOULE (1840s) — paddle-wheel experiment showed mechanical work converts to heat (1 calorie ≈ 4.18 joules). HELMHOLTZ formalized as 'conservation of energy' (1847). PYQ FREQUENCY: 1st law statement is a 1-mark guarantee in NEET, JEE-Main, NCERT-driven SSC. EXAMINER MINDSET: tests recognition of energy-conservation principle.

questions.stem: The SECOND LAW of thermodynamics is associated with which physical quantity?

options.option_text: Pressure of the gas mixture (option here)
Volume of the system always (option here)

questions.explanation: SECOND LAW: in any spontaneous process in an ISOLATED SYSTEM, ENTROPY (S) ALWAYS INCREASES (or stays constant for reversible processes). ΔS_universe ≥ 0. ENTROPY = measure of DISORDER or NUMBER OF MICROSTATES (Boltzmann: S = k·ln Ω). EQUIVALENT STATEMENTS of 2nd law: (1) KELVIN-PLANCK — no engine can convert heat ENTIRELY into work (always some waste heat). (2) CLAUSIUS — heat flows SPONTANEOUSLY from HOT to COLD (never reverse, without external work). (3) ENTROPY STATEMENT — universe entropy increases. CONSEQUENCES: (a) NO 100% EFFICIENT heat engine. (b) HEAT FLOWS one direction (without input). (c) PERPETUAL MOTION 2nd kind (extracting work from heat with no waste) FORBIDDEN. CARNOT EFFICIENCY (max possible): η = 1 − T_cold/T_hot (in Kelvin). EXAMPLE: car engine ~30% efficient; Carnot maximum (~700K combustion / 300K ambient) = 1 − 300/700 ≈ 57%. ENTROPY in EVERYDAY: ice melts spontaneously (water more disordered than ice); ice doesn't form spontaneously (needs energy input). DEATH OF UNIVERSE: 'Heat Death' — eventually all energy becomes uniform low-grade heat; no work possible (theoretical, ~10¹⁰⁰ years). PYQ FREQUENCY: 2nd law + entropy in NEET, JEE-Main 2-3× per paper.

questions.stem: The ZEROTH LAW of thermodynamics establishes the concept of:

options.option_text: Entropy as a state function here

questions.explanation: ZEROTH LAW: 'IF two systems are each in thermal equilibrium with a THIRD system, then they are in thermal equilibrium with EACH OTHER.' This establishes the concept of TEMPERATURE — a property that determines whether two systems will exchange heat. WHY 'ZEROTH'? Discovered/articulated AFTER the first and second laws (early 20th century by R.H. Fowler), but considered MORE FUNDAMENTAL — needed to define temperature itself; hence numbered 'zeroth' so as not to disturb the existing 1st-2nd numbering. PRACTICAL CONSEQUENCE: thermometers work because of zeroth law — when a thermometer reaches equilibrium with object A and shows X°C, and reaches equilibrium with object B and ALSO shows X°C, A and B are at the same temperature (would not exchange heat if put together). TEMPERATURE SCALES: (1) CELSIUS — 0°C (water freezes), 100°C (water boils, at 1 atm). (2) FAHRENHEIT — 32°F (freeze), 212°F (boil); F = 9/5 C + 32. (3) KELVIN — absolute scale; 0 K = absolute zero (−273.15°C). T(K) = T(°C) + 273.15. KELVIN is used in scientific equations (especially gas laws, thermodynamics). PYQ FREQUENCY: zeroth law in NEET, JEE-Main 1× per cycle. EXAMINER MINDSET: tests definition of temperature.

questions.stem: The THIRD LAW of thermodynamics states that as temperature approaches absolute zero:

options.option_text: Entropy of a perfect crystal approaches zero

questions.explanation: THIRD LAW: as TEMPERATURE T → 0 K (absolute zero, −273.15°C), the ENTROPY of a PERFECT CRYSTAL → 0. Statement by NERNST (1906) — known as Nernst Heat Theorem; PLANCK extended it. INTUITION: at absolute zero, atoms have minimum thermal motion; only one possible microstate (all atoms in their ground state, perfectly aligned in crystal lattice) → entropy log(1) = 0. CONSEQUENCES: (1) Absolute zero is UNATTAINABLE — you can approach but never reach it (would require infinite work). (2) ENTROPY at any finite T can be measured ABSOLUTELY, not just relatively. (3) Heat capacity → 0 as T → 0 (Debye/Einstein models). LOWEST T EVER ACHIEVED in lab: ~38 picokelvin (38 × 10⁻¹² K, achieved 2021 in Bose-Einstein condensate experiments). NOT TO BE CONFUSED with TEMPERATURE LIMITS in nature — Cosmic Microwave Background ≈ 2.7 K (universe's residual heat from Big Bang). NEUTRON STARS interior ~10⁹ K (extremely hot); white dwarfs cool over billions of years. APPLICATION — CRYOGENICS: liquid nitrogen (77 K), liquid helium (4 K) — used for MRI superconductors, low-T research, biological sample preservation. PYQ FREQUENCY: 3rd law in NEET, JEE-Main 1× per 2 cycles.

questions.stem: A CARNOT engine operating between 600 K and 300 K has maximum efficiency of:
questions.explanation: CARNOT EFFICIENCY (theoretical maximum for any heat engine between two reservoirs): η = 1 − T_cold/T_hot, where T in KELVIN. Plug T_cold = 300 K, T_hot = 600 K: η = 1 − 300/600 = 1 − 0.5 = 0.5 = 50%. INTERPRETATION: at most 50% of input heat can be converted to work; the other 50% is rejected as waste heat to the cold reservoir. KEY: T must be in KELVIN (NEVER Celsius); using Celsius gives wrong answers. CARNOT CYCLE — ideal reversible 4-step cycle: (1) Isothermal expansion (Q absorbed at T_hot). (2) Adiabatic expansion (T drops to T_cold). (3) Isothermal compression (Q rejected at T_cold). (4) Adiabatic compression (T rises back to T_hot). REAL ENGINES: less efficient than Carnot (irreversibilities, friction, finite-rate heat transfer). Internal combustion engines: ~25-30% efficient (T_hot ~ 2500 K, T_cold ~ 600 K → Carnot max ~76%). DIESEL: ~40%. STEAM TURBINES: ~35-40%. COMBINED CYCLE GAS TURBINE (CCGT): ~60% efficient (highest commercial). PYQ FREQUENCY: Carnot efficiency calculations in NEET, JEE-Main 2-3× per paper. EXAMINER MINDSET: tests Kelvin discipline.

questions.stem: A REFRIGERATOR works on which thermodynamic principle?

options.option_text: Reverse of heat engine cycle (heat pump)
Cold air settles at the bottom

questions.explanation: REFRIGERATOR (and AC) — operates as a HEAT PUMP — REVERSE of a heat engine. Instead of converting heat → work, it uses WORK INPUT to PUMP HEAT from a COLD reservoir (inside) to a HOT reservoir (outside). This DOESN'T VIOLATE 2nd law because work is added (overall entropy of universe still increases). REFRIGERATION CYCLE — 4 stages: (1) COMPRESSOR — refrigerant compressed (T rises). (2) CONDENSER (at back) — refrigerant gives off heat to room air (T drops to liquid). (3) EXPANSION VALVE — pressure drops; refrigerant cools rapidly. (4) EVAPORATOR (inside fridge) — refrigerant absorbs heat from food (T rises to gas), then back to compressor. COEFFICIENT OF PERFORMANCE (COP): COP = Q_cold / W_input. Typically 2-5; can be > 1 (no contradiction; you're MOVING heat, not creating energy). REFRIGERANTS: historically CFCs (Freon, R-12, R-22) — banned due to ozone-layer depletion (Montreal Protocol 1987). Now HFCs (R-134a, R-410A) — climate impact concern; HFOs (R-1234yf) increasingly used. INDIA: ENERGY EFFICIENCY star ratings (BEE) for ACs and refrigerators — 5-star = most efficient. PYQ FREQUENCY: refrigeration in NEET, JEE-Main 1× per cycle.

questions.stem: ABSOLUTE ZERO temperature in Celsius is approximately:
questions.explanation: ABSOLUTE ZERO = 0 KELVIN = −273.15°C = −459.67°F. The COLDEST POSSIBLE TEMPERATURE — at which all molecular thermal motion theoretically ceases. WHY UNREACHABLE? 3rd law of thermodynamics: it would require infinite work/cooling steps. REAL EXPERIMENTS: lowest LAB temperature ~38 picokelvin (NASA Cold Atom Lab on ISS, Bose-Einstein condensates, 2021). DERIVATION: by extrapolation of CHARLES'S LAW (V ∝ T) — V → 0 at T → −273.15°C; gases would have zero volume at absolute zero. SCALES BUILT ON ABSOLUTE ZERO: KELVIN (K), RANKINE (°R, used in some US engineering). KELVIN is the SI unit of temperature. CONNECTION to QUANTUM MECHANICS: at very low T, particles obey QUANTUM STATISTICS — bosons can occupy same state (Bose-Einstein condensates), fermions can't (Fermi gas). SUPERCONDUCTIVITY emerges at T < critical temperature (e.g., niobium at 9.3 K, YBa₂Cu₃O₇ at 92 K — 'high-Tc' superconductor). COSMIC LIMITS: CMB ≈ 2.725 K; deep space ≈ 2-3 K (uniform cosmic background). RECENT (2024) — discoveries of room-temperature superconductors remain CONTROVERSIAL. PYQ FREQUENCY: absolute zero is a 1-mark guarantee in NEET, JEE-Main, NCERT-driven SSC.
